laterSettingsHashObservation.note: A later read-only pre-push audit differed from the matching probe-boundary hashes. No settings contents were read, no restore or write was attempted, and no further native probe was run.

capabilities.question: Which reads answer from $.process under Claude session markers?
evidence: Claude Code 2.1.319 --version and plugin --help exit 0 under isolated HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.

ahub 0.35.0 source CLI child argv under CLAUDECODE=1, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=c0-isolated-session, AGENTHUB_PEER_ID=claude: status --json, board --json and projects --json exit 0 against an isolated registered scratch daemon.
No call from an actual running mod through $.process was observed. CLI subprocess proof is narrower than host API proof.
capabilities.consequence: C1 may use these fixed read argv only after a native mod $.process receipt; no effect command or automatic launcher is admitted.

capabilities.question: Does session.receive see agent-hub deliveries and which origin?
evidence: No channel plugin or native peer was loaded; no inbound channel event was observed.
claude plugin test can load a scratch hooks module and pass an empty assertion, but its synthetic session.receive method is not channel delivery evidence.
capabilities.consequence: Drop channel-row rendering and delivery-trigger refresh. Keep session-start, turn-end, completed hub-tool and person-refresh candidates subject to their own receipts.

capabilities.question: Does $.ui.status coexist with statusLine and statusline-tee?
evidence: The real settings.json SHA-256 is unchanged; no real statusLine or tee was run or edited.
No native status entry plus user statusLine plus quota-tee session was observed in the isolated profile.
capabilities.consequence: Drop the status-line entry; do not alter statusLine or quota capture. Pane and attention band are independent, still unqualified.

capabilities.question: What are command.run origins for composer, model and plugin?
evidence: plugin test help describes a host-like test environment, not a native person gesture.
No person Enter, model-invoked command or plugin-triggered command origin was captured from an interactive session.
capabilities.consequence: No effectful slash command is admitted. C1 must prove composer origin; other origins get text only. Console remains printed guidance.

capabilities.question: Which surfaces actually draw panes and bands?
evidence: No pane or AbovePrompt band was rendered in an interactive terminal.
Desktop, VS Code and mobile were not driven; each receipt is NOT RUN.
capabilities.consequence: No terminal or other surface is supported yet. Drop each unproven surface separately; no support inference from a terminal test or typings.

capabilities.question: What is the minimum supported Claude Code version?
evidence: Only installed Claude Code 2.1.319 was executed.
plugin init, plugin validate help and plugin test help are available at that version. No older version or native mod UX was qualified.
capabilities.consequence: 2.1.319 is the observed CLI version, not a minimum or supported-mod claim. C1 must qualify a version and feature-detect APIs; older or unknown hosts refuse.

capabilities.question: Is ahub tail a safe event source?
evidence: Against the scratch daemon, ahub --project <root> tail exits 1: claude cannot run ahub tail; inherited Claude markers identify the agent shell.
src/cli/main.ts tail renders event, context, notice and permission free text. It is not a bounded closed public-field event stream.
capabilities.consequence: Exclude tail entirely. No polling timer or log stream replaces it; refresh remains event-driven or person-driven.

fixture.pii: A board title containing [pii] yields its id only. Never copy detail, notes, paths, doing, logs or review bodies.
fixture.ceiling: In-memory specification fixture, not shipped parsing code or native host emulation. New status fields for budget, permission and held delivery detail remain unavailable until their public shape is proven; missing is partial, never zero.
fixture.refresh: No timer. Future event-trigger refresh: one in-flight read, coalesced, minimum interval 1000 ms. No delivery trigger before channel-receive proof.
fixture.binding: Read projects registration before status and board. Exactly one exact real root and id; recheck each refresh. Missing, changed or duplicate refuses before further reads. This C0 fixture tests status binding only; registration orchestration belongs to C1.
fixture.persistence: No store, settings, logs or credentials. Future mod state only in per-session $.state.

baseline.rule: One explicit chord/click that changes focus or opens a terminal, or one submitted command, is one action. Typing within the same submitted command and waiting add none. Start: Claude session focused, exact project root known, no separate terminal open. End: existing screen visibly answers the question. Consent and project selection, if needed, add one action each.

steps: Submit ahub --project <quoted root> console (one action); inspect the existing attention screen and its person-only commands.
